name: Assisted Pull Up
instructions: Use the machine or band for assistance and start from a full hang. Pull your chest toward the bar with controlled movement.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Brace your core, sit down and back, and keep knees tracking over toes. Drive up through midfoot to stand.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back and row the bar toward your stomach. Lower under control without jerking.

name: Bench Press
instructions: Lower the bar to mid-chest with control and press up powerfully. Keep shoulder blades retracted throughout.

name: Bicep Curl
instructions: Keep elbows close to your sides and curl the weight up smoothly. Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Maintain a slight bend in the elbows and bring hands together in front of your chest. Squeeze, then return under control.

name: Cable Crunches
instructions: Kneel facing the cable and crunch by rounding the spine. Pull ribs toward hips, not with your arms.

name: Calf Raises
instructions: Rise onto the balls of your feet and squeeze calves at the top. Lower slowly into a full stretch.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Set a tight back, push the floor away, and stand tall. Lower the bar with control while hinging at the hips.

name: Decline Bench Press
instructions: Lower the bar to lower chest and press upward smoothly. Keep glutes and shoulders firmly on the bench.

name: Dumbbell Flyes
instructions: Lower arms wide with a slight elbow bend until chest stretches. Bring dumbbells together by squeezing the chest.

name: Face Pulls
instructions: Pull the rope toward your face with elbows high. Squeeze rear delts and upper back at the end.

name: Front Raises
instructions: Lift the weights to shoulder height with straight but relaxed arms. Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Curl with palms facing each other and keep torso still. Control both lifting and lowering phases.

name: Hanging Leg Raises
instructions: Hang from the bar and raise legs using your abs. Avoid swinging and lower under control.

name: Lateral Raises
instructions: Raise arms out to the sides until shoulder height. Lead with elbows and avoid shrugging.

name: Leg Curl
instructions: Curl heels toward glutes while keeping hips down. Control the movement through the full range.

name: Push-Ups
instructions: Maintain a straight body line and lower chest toward the floor. Push up while keeping core tight.

name: Reverse Flyes
instructions: Hinge forward and open arms wide. Focus on squeezing rear shoulders, not swinging the weights.

name: Skull Crushers
instructions: Lower the bar toward your forehead with elbows fixed. Extend arms to full lockout smoothly.

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Keep elbows pinned to your sides and extend arms downward. Control the return without using momentum.

name: Running
instructions: Run with an upright posture and relaxed shoulders. Maintain a steady pace and controlled breathing.
